basics.name: Gabriel Favot
basics.label: Fullstack Engineer
basics.summary: Fullstack Engineer with over 7 years of experience building scalable products in fast-growing startups.

work.name: Beamy
work.summary: SaaS Governance for enterprise accounts — 13-person tech & data team.
highlights: Multi-tenant, multi-database platform (40 clients, 6 repositories): fullstack development and ownership of all deployments on GCP and Kubernetes.
Cut SaaS portfolio load time from 10 s to 2 s with caching over 4 data sources across databases, up to 5,000 SaaS × 40 properties per client.
Browser extension deployed to 100,000+ employees: analyses browsing traffic to detect SaaS usage and surface shadow IT to client IT departments.
Initiated the whole engineering team's shift to AI-assisted development: GitHub Copilot from 2022, then a team-wide move to Cursor.
Applied Hexagonal Architecture and clean code across several projects: domain isolated from infrastructure, testable code.

work.name: Manager.one
work.summary: Web developer on a professional online banking platform and white-label ecosystem.
highlights: Contributed to the development of a large-scale B2B professional banking solution.
Held full ownership of 2 white-label projects: managed direct client relationships (from requirements gathering to feedback), technical implementation, and final delivery.
Led a team of 3 developers, conducting code reviews and mentoring on best practices.

work.name: Air France
work.summary: Frontend development on an internal operational tool using Angular and TypeScript.
highlights: Built reusable UI components and integrated REST APIs
Worked in a small agile team with direct stakeholder interaction

projects.name: Apartment Full Renovation
projects.description: End-to-end renovation of a residential property.
highlights: Planned and executed a complete renovation, including bathroom remodeling and electrical system upgrades.

projects.name: Personal Home Server & Homelab
projects.description: Self-hosted infrastructure managing home automation and private cloud services.
highlights: Architected a home server (proxmox) hosting multiple open-source services and custom micro-apps via Docker.
Developed several applications and workflows for private use (web scraping, automation, etc.). Including https://cv.gab.pm.
Maintained the infrastructure and hosted services.

projects.name: Spotify Listening History
projects.description: A personal proof of concept developed to visualize Spotify listening history and real-time playback through a dynamic and immersive interface.
highlights: Built with Nuxt 3 and integrated Spotify Web API to fetch and process real-time listening data and history.
